Commercial Hail Damage Portfolio Roofing Frisco TX — IKO Certified (RCAT #03-0637)

Pineapple Roofing (RCAT Licensed #03-0637 · IKO Certified) is the multi-unit, HOA and commercial-portfolio hail-damage roofer for Frisco, McKinney, Plano and Allen. Priority-tier portfolio agreements with a 72-hour storm-response SLA. Every property starts with a Complimentary Professional Photo Audit (CPPA). Call (972) 928-0788.

When North Texas hail hits, a property manager's problem multiplies by the number of buildings. Tenants call, insurers stall, and every day of delay compounds water intrusion and liability. You need one accountable roofer who can assess an entire portfolio fast, document it for insurance, and execute across every building to the same standard.

Built for portfolios, not just single roofs - **Multi-building assessment** — we scope every roof in your portfolio, prioritized by damage severity. - **72-hour storm-response SLA** — priority-tier agreements get us on-site fast after a named event. - **Insurance-ready documentation** — photo audits, moisture readings and written scope per building. - **Commercial systems** — TPO, PVC, modified bitumen and metal, installed and maintained to spec.

Who we serve - **Property managers** overseeing multi-family and mixed-use portfolios. - **HOAs** managing community roofs and common structures. - **Commercial owners** — retail, office, industrial and hospitality across Frisco and DFW.

How a portfolio engagement works 1. **Complimentary Professional Photo Audit (CPPA)** — full documented assessment across every building. 2. **Prioritized scope & schedule** — highest-severity roofs first, phased to minimize disruption. 3. **Claims managed with you** — we meet adjusters on site, per building, and advocate for fair, full coverage. 4. **IKO Certified execution** — consistent craftsmanship across the portfolio, backed by warranty and a maintenance program.

Why property managers choose Pineapple Roofing - **20+ years** in North Texas — local since 2005, through every storm season. - **IKO Certified · RCAT #03-0637** — verifiable, accountable, insured. - **Single point of contact** — one roofer, one standard, across every building.

Serving Frisco & the DFW metro Frisco (75033 · 75034 · 75035), Lewisville (75067), The Colony (75068), plus McKinney, Plano and Allen.

Frequently asked questions

Can you assess an entire multi-building portfolio after a storm? Yes. We scope every roof, prioritize by severity, and deliver a per-building documented report your insurer accepts.

What is the 72-hour storm-response SLA? Priority-tier portfolio partners get on-site assessment within 72 hours of a named storm event — so damage is documented and mitigated fast.

Do you handle commercial insurance claims? Yes — photo audit, written scope and adjuster meetings, per building, managed alongside you.

What commercial roofing systems do you install? TPO, PVC, modified bitumen and metal — matched to each building's slope, use and budget.

Do you offer ongoing maintenance for portfolios? Yes. Scheduled inspections and minor repairs extend roof life and protect your manufacturer warranties.

Book a portfolio Complimentary Professional Photo Audit Protect every building the right way — start with one call. 📞 **Call (972) 928-0788** — IKO Certified · RCAT #03-0637 · The Pineapple Standard.

Frisco sits in the heart of hail country. The tricky part: hail damage is often invisible from the ground. Your shingles can be bruised and shedding granules while the roof still "looks fine" — until the next storm turns it into an interior leak. The window to catch it (and claim it) is smaller than most homeowners think.

What hail does to a Frisco roof - **Granule loss** — hail knocks the protective granules off, exposing the asphalt mat to UV and accelerating failure. - **Bruising** — soft impact points that compromise the shingle's seal. - **Cracked or split shingles** — especially on older or brittle roofs. - **Dented flashing, vents and gutters** — the metal shows the story even when shingles hide it.

Large estates in Starwood, Newman Village and Stonebriar often carry Class 4 impact-rated systems — but even those need a documented post-storm assessment to protect the warranty and the claim.

Why the documentation matters Insurers approve claims that are documented thoroughly and early. A vague "looks damaged" gets denied; a photo-backed, itemized scope gets approved. That's the difference our CPPA makes — and why 400+ North Texas families trust us after a storm.

Will filing a hail claim raise my rates? Hail is typically a weather event, not driver-related. Many homeowners file without a rate change — but always confirm with your carrier.

Do you work directly with my insurance company? Yes. We document the damage, meet your adjuster on site, and manage the claim with you start to finish.

Storm Damage Roof Repair Frisco TX — IKO Certified (RCAT #03-0637)

Pineapple Roofing (RCAT Licensed #03-0637 · IKO Certified) is the storm-damage roofer for Frisco ZIPs 75033, 75034, 75035, 75067 and 75068. Every project starts with a Complimentary Professional Photo Audit (CPPA) — no cost, no pressure. Call (972) 928-0788.

North Texas storms don't ask permission. One hail event or high-wind night can leave your Frisco roof with damage you can't see from the ground — and by the time a leak shows up inside, the repair is bigger and costlier than it had to be. We've protected North Texas roofs since 2005, and we document everything before we ever recommend a thing.

What storm damage actually looks like in Frisco A trained inspector checks for the damage untrained eyes miss:

- Hail bruising — soft, dark spots where granules are knocked off, exposing the mat. Often invisible from the ground. - Wind-lifted or missing shingles — especially along ridges and edges. - Damaged flashing — around chimneys, vents and valleys, where leaks start. - Granules in the gutters — a sign the surface is wearing prematurely.

Frisco's mix of new-construction neighborhoods (Phillips Creek Ranch, Lawler Park) and established estates (Starwood, Newman Village, Stonebriar) all take North Texas hail differently — the assessment has to match the roof.

How our storm process works 1. **Complimentary Professional Photo Audit (CPPA)** — our IKO Certified team documents the roof, attic and exterior with photos. You get a clear, written read on what's urgent and what can wait. 2. **Insurance documentation** — that photo report becomes the evidence for your claim, done right and early. 3. **We meet your adjuster on site** — so nothing gets missed or downplayed. You never negotiate with the insurance company alone. 4. **IKO Certified repair or replacement** — installed to The Pineapple Standard, backed by a 50-year product warranty.

Why Frisco homeowners choose Pineapple Roofing - **Local since 2005** — based in North Texas, not a storm-chasing crew that disappears after the next hail event. - **IKO Certified** — certified installs, 50-year product warranties. - **RCAT License #03-0637** — a verifiable, accountable Texas contractor. - **5-star rated** by 400+ North Texas homeowners.

Serving all of Frisco and North Texas Frisco (75033 · 75034 · 75035), Lewisville (75067), The Colony/Frisco S (75068), plus Plano, McKinney and Allen. From The Star to Stonebriar, we know these roofs.

Frequently asked questions

How do I know if my Frisco roof needs replacement or just repair? That depends on age, damage extent and what's underneath. The CPPA gives you a documented read and an honest recommendation — repair or replace — not a hard sell.

How long do I have to file a hail damage claim in Texas? Texas generally allows up to 12 months, but the sooner you document, the stronger the claim. We recommend a CPPA right after any significant storm.

Does homeowners insurance cover hail damage in Frisco? Most policies do. The key is thorough documentation — which is exactly what our photo audit and written scope provide.

What is the difference between IKO and other shingles? We're IKO Certified, which means our installs are trained and audited to IKO's spec — the standard that unlocks the 50-year product warranty and our workmanship coverage.

What is a roof inspection vs a CPPA? A CPPA is a Complimentary Professional Photo Audit — a documented, photo-based assessment of your roof at no cost and no obligation. It's our version of a first inspection, done right.

Book your Complimentary Professional Photo Audit Storm rolled through Frisco? The smartest first step costs you nothing. 📞 **Call (972) 928-0788** — IKO Certified · RCAT #03-0637 · The Pineapple Standard.

Bringing Your Space Back to Life

We Handle Your Roof Insurance Claim With You

A denied or underpaid claim can cost you thousands. The difference is documentation done right, early — and that's exactly what we do. You're never negotiating with the insurance company alone.

How our claims process works

1. Complimentary Professional Photo Audit (CPPA) — we photograph and document every damage point: hail bruising, wind lift, flashing, granule loss. 2. Written scope — a clear, itemized report your insurer accepts. 3. We meet your adjuster on site — so nothing gets missed or downplayed. 4. We manage the claim with you — from first inspection to final repair.

Why homeowners trust us with claims

- IKO Certified, RCAT-licensed (#03-0637) — a legitimate, accountable contractor. - 20+ years handling North Texas storm claims. - Honest documentation — we advocate for a fair, fully-covered repair.

Don't wait for the claim window to close

North Texas claim deadlines are real. Book your CPPA today — (972) 928-0788 — and get your roof documented before it's too late.

Seamless Gutter Installation in Dallas, TX

Pineapple Roofing provides gutter installation services in Dallas for homes and light commercial properties needing dependable drainage. Custom-fit systems help direct rainwater away from foundations, siding, and landscaping while reducing overflow at roof edges. Careful measurements, clean installation practices, and practical material options support longer-lasting exterior protection in changing Texas weather.
  • Roof Replacement
  • Roof Repair
  • Roofing Services

Get your FREE

Quote Today

By pressing 'Get a FREE Quote' you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and privacy policy, and consenting to receive text messages. To unsubscribe, text STOP to 972-928-0788.

Built for better drainage

Choose Pineapple Roofing for Seamless Gutter Installation in Dallas, TX

  • Precise Fit for Cleaner Performance: Pineapple Roofing measures rooflines carefully and plans downspout placement around valleys, corners, and runoff volume. That detail-focused process helps reduce weak spots where leaks or overflow often start, especially on longer eaves where poorly aligned sections can send water toward fascia boards and entry areas.
  • Smoother Scheduling and Installation Flow: Pineapple Roofing keeps gutter projects organized from measurement through final attachment, helping property owners prepare around workdays, tenant access, or exterior improvements. When installation is coordinated with roof work, painting, or landscaping, a clear process helps limit disruption and keeps exterior projects moving efficiently.
  • Consistent Solutions for Different Properties: Pineapple Roofing installs drainage systems for single-family homes, duplexes, and small commercial buildings, matching layout and capacity to each structure. That reliability matters when a steep roof sheds heavy rain quickly or when a property owner needs Seamless Gutter Installation in Dallas, TX that suits both function and appearance.
Control runoff effectively

Why Seamless Gutter Installation in Dallas, TX Matters for Long-Term Protection

  • Texas Storms Demand Better Drainage: Sudden downpours can dump large amounts of water on a roof in a short time, making controlled runoff essential. In Dallas, TX, properly installed gutters help move rain away from foundations, walkways, and planting beds before pooling creates erosion, staining, or slippery surfaces around the property.
  • Neglected Runoff Can Affect Daily Living: Water spilling near entrances, patios, or driveways can create messy conditions that interfere with everyday use of the property. Better drainage helps reduce splashback on siding, muddy areas near doors, and the frustration of managing recurring water problems after ordinary seasonal storms.
  • Exterior Condition Influences Property Readiness: A well-drained exterior is easier to maintain before move-ins, showings, inspections, or routine upkeep. Gutter systems that channel water correctly help preserve trim, soffits, and surrounding grounds, making the property feel more prepared and reducing the chance that standing water delays other exterior maintenance tasks.
Get a Free Quote FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Seamless Gutter Installation in Dallas, TX

Review common questions about gutter installation timing, materials, and property-specific drainage needs for homes and buildings across Dallas, TX.
Do I need Gutter Installation in Dallas, TX for a house with frequent water pooling near the foundation? Yes, recurring pooling near the foundation often signals that roof runoff is not being directed far enough away from the structure. Pineapple Roofing assesses drainage paths, roof edges, and downspout placement so homeowners can choose a gutter system that better protects soil, concrete, and lower wall areas.
When is the best time to schedule Gutter Installation in Dallas, TX for a newly purchased home? The best time is usually before heavy seasonal rain or soon after purchase, especially if drainage issues appear during inspection. Pineapple Roofing can review the roofline early, identify runoff trouble spots, and help new homeowners coordinate installation before landscaping, painting, or foundation concerns become more complicated.
What materials are commonly used for Gutter Installation in Dallas, TX on duplexes and small commercial buildings? Common options include aluminum for low maintenance, steel for added strength, and copper for a distinct appearance on select properties. Pineapple Roofing helps owners compare material performance, appearance, and drainage needs so the final system fits the building layout, expected runoff, and maintenance preferences.

When a ceiling stain appears after overnight rain or a branch lifts shingles, organized service helps reduce interior disruption and added moisture exposure.
  • Reliable Repairs for Different Properties: Pineapple Roofing handles roof issues on single-family homes, duplexes, and rental properties with repair methods matched to the roof’s condition and material type. For owners managing property concerns in Dallas, TX, consistent communication and documented repair steps make the process clearer from inspection through final cleanup.
Timely repairs matter

Why Expert Roof Repair in Dallas, TX Protects Homes and Buildings

  • Storm Patterns Create Ongoing Risk: Hail, wind-driven rain, and intense summer heat can loosen roofing materials and expose vulnerable seams over time. In Dallas, roofs often face repeated weather stress, so timely repairs help stop minor damage from turning into widespread moisture intrusion or decking deterioration.
  • Leaks Can Affect Indoor Health: Even a small roof opening can allow moisture into insulation, ceilings, and wall cavities, creating conditions where musty odors and material breakdown become more likely. Addressing damage quickly supports a drier interior environment and lowers the chance of hidden water-related issues spreading through occupied spaces.
  • Property Standards Still Matter: Visible roof damage can affect how a home, rental, or small commercial building is perceived by neighbors, buyers, and tenants. Prompt repair supports a more maintained appearance, helps properties stay ready for inspections, and reduces the chance that exterior wear signals larger maintenance problems.

Frequently Asked Questions About Expert Roof Repair in Dallas, TX

Find answers about roof repair warning signs, repair scope, and scheduling considerations for homes, rentals, and storm-damaged properties in Dallas, TX.
What problems can Roof Repair in Dallas, TX fix after a hailstorm on a residential roof?
Roof repair can address cracked shingles, punctures, loosened flashing, exposed underlayment, and small leak points caused by hail impact or wind. Pineapple Roofing evaluates storm-related damage carefully so homeowners receive repairs that match the affected areas instead of broad work that may not be necessary.
Can Roof Repair in Dallas, TX be scheduled for a duplex with an active leak during the rainy season?
Yes, many repairs can be scheduled during wet periods, although exact timing depends on safety, roof access, and whether temporary protection is needed first. Pineapple Roofing helps duplex owners plan practical next steps, including inspection timing, moisture control, and repair sequencing when rain remains in the forecast.
What should I expect during Roof Repair in Dallas, TX for a rental property with missing shingles?
Most projects involve an inspection, damage review, material matching, repair work, and cleanup, with scope depending on whether underlying components were affected. Pineapple Roofing works with landlords and managers to explain access needs, likely repair areas, and how the work can be coordinated around tenant occupancy.

Professional Roof Replacement in Dallas, TX

Pineapple Roofing provides complete roof replacement services across Dallas, replacing worn shingles, storm-damaged sections, and aging roofing systems with durable materials and careful installation. Clear project planning, consistent communication, and dependable jobsite cleanup help homeowners and property managers move forward with confidence when a roof has reached the end of its service life.
  • Roof Replacement
  • Roof Repair
  • Roofing Services

Get your FREE

Quote Today

By pressing 'Get a FREE Quote' you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and privacy policy, and consenting to receive text messages. To unsubscribe, text STOP to 972-928-0788.

Built for lasting protection

Experience Lasting Results with Pineapple Roofing - Your Professional Roof Replacement in Dallas, TX

  • Careful Replacement Planning: Pineapple Roofing starts each roof replacement with a detailed assessment of decking condition, ventilation, flashing, and drainage points so hidden issues are addressed before new materials go on. That process helps prevent common callbacks, especially on older homes where multiple roofing layers or past patchwork can conceal underlying damage.
  • Streamlined Scheduling for Busy Properties: Pineapple Roofing coordinates tear-off, material delivery, installation sequencing, and cleanup to reduce disruption for homeowners and managers in Dallas, TX. When a family is juggling school schedules or a rental home needs quick turnover, organized timelines make replacing the roof far less stressful and more predictable.

content.raw:
Privacy Policy

Welcome to Pineapple Roofing! This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, disclose, and manage your information. Your privacy is important to us, and we are committed to handling your personal information responsibly and transparently.

INTRODUCTION

This Privacy Policy explains the practices of Pineapple Roofing (“we,” “our,” or “us”) regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information when you engage with our services, including contacting us about roofing services. By using our services, you agree to the terms outlined in this policy.

CHANGES TO OUR PRIVACY POLICY

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal requirements. Any updates will be posted on our website, and we encourage you to review this policy from time to time.

WHAT TYPE OF INFORMATION DO WE COLLECT?

We collect the following types of information to provide and improve our services:

  • Contact Information: This includes your name, email address, phone number, and property address, which we use to communicate with you regarding roofing services.
  • Service Details: Information relevant to your request, such as roofing issues, project scope, inspection details, and scheduling preferences.
  • Browsing Data: When you interact with our website or online services, we may collect non personal data such as your IP address, browser type, and technical information to improve performance.

HOW DO WE USE THE INFORMATION THAT WE COLLECT?

We use your information only to:

  • Contact You: To communicate with you about your service request, provide estimates, confirm appointments, and answer questions.
  • Improve Our Services: To enhance and personalize our services based on feedback and usage.
  • Legal Compliance: To comply with applicable laws and regulations regarding data use.

SMS OPT-IN CONSENT AND PHONE NUMBER PRIVACY

We collect phone numbers only with your express opt in consent to receive SMS communications from Pineapple Roofing. We use these numbers solely for communication regarding your services. Your phone numbers and SMS consent information will not be shared with third parties under any circumstances.

TYPES OF SMS COMMUNICATIONS

By opting in to SMS communications from Pineapple Roofing, you may receive messages related to:

  • Appointment reminders
  • Project updates
  • Estimates and invoices
  • General customer service inquiries

STANDARD SMS DISCLOSURES

  • Messaging frequency may vary.
  • Message and data rates may apply.
  • To opt out of SMS communications at any time, reply STOP.
  • For assistance, reply HELP.

OPT-IN CONSENT

By providing your phone number and explicitly opting in, you consent to receive SMS messages from Pineapple Roofing. Consent is not a condition of service, and you may opt out at any time by replying STOP.

OPT-OUT INSTRUCTIONS

To stop receiving SMS messages from Pineapple Roofing, reply STOP to any message. You will receive a confirmation message, and no further messages will be sent.

HELP INSTRUCTIONS

For assistance, reply HELP to any message. You may also contact us via:

  • Phone: (972) 928-0788
  • Email: support@pineappleroofingllc.com
  • Website: pineappleroofingllc.com

WITH WHOM DO WE SHARE INFORMATION THAT WE COLLECT?

Pineapple Roofing does not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. We may share your information with:

  • Service Providers: Trusted partners who assist in operating our business and are obligated to keep your information secure and confidential.
  • Legal Authorities: If required by law, we may disclose information to governmental authorities as part of legal proceedings or investigations.
  • No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

COOKIES AND SIMILAR TECHNOLOGY

Our services may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience and analyze usage.

HOW WE MANAGE YOUR COOKIES

You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Blocking cookies may impact your experience.

WHO CAN YOU CONTACT FOR MORE INFORMATION?

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or our data handling practices, please reach out to us:

  • Phone: (972) 928-0788
  • Email: support@pineappleroofingllc.com
  • Website: pineappleroofingllc.com

Thank you for trusting Pineapple Roofing with your information. We are dedicated to protecting your privacy and providing a safe and transparent experience.

      SMS OPT-IN CONSENT AND PHONE NUMBER PRIVACY<\/h2>

      We collect phone numbers only with your express opt in consent to receive SMS communications from Pineapple Roofing. We use these numbers solely for communication regarding your services. Your phone numbers and SMS consent information will not be shared with third parties under any circumstances.<\/p>

      TYPES OF SMS COMMUNICATIONS<\/h3>

      By opting in to SMS communications from Pineapple Roofing, you may receive messages related to:<\/p>

      • Appointment reminders<\/li>
      • Project updates<\/li>
      • Estimates and invoices<\/li>
      • General customer service inquiries<\/li><\/ul>

        STANDARD SMS DISCLOSURES<\/h4>
        • Messaging frequency may vary.<\/li>
        • Message and data rates may apply.<\/li>
        • To opt out of SMS communications at any time, reply STOP.<\/li>
        • For assistance, reply HELP.<\/li><\/ul>

          OPT-IN CONSENT<\/h4>

          By providing your phone number and explicitly opting in, you consent to receive SMS messages from Pineapple Roofing. Consent is not a condition of service, and you may opt out at any time by replying STOP.<\/p>

          OPT-OUT INSTRUCTIONS<\/h4>

          To stop receiving SMS messages from Pineapple Roofing, reply STOP to any message. You will receive a confirmation message, and no further messages will be sent.<\/p>

          HELP INSTRUCTIONS<\/h4>

          For assistance, reply HELP to any message. You may also contact us via:<\/p>

          • Phone<\/strong>: (972) 928-0788<\/li>
          • Email<\/strong>: support@pineappleroofingllc.com<\/li>
          • Website<\/strong>: pineappleroofingllc.com<\/li><\/ul>

            WITH WHOM DO WE SHARE INFORMATION THAT WE COLLECT?<\/h2>

            Pineapple Roofing does not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. We may share your information with:<\/p>

            • Service Providers<\/strong>: Trusted partners who assist in operating our business and are obligated to keep your information secure and confidential.<\/li>
            • Legal Authorities<\/strong>: If required by law, we may disclose information to governmental authorities as part of legal proceedings or investigations.<\/li>
            • No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.<\/li><\/ul>

              COOKIES AND SIMILAR TECHNOLOGY<\/h2>

              Our services may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience and analyze usage.<\/p>

              HOW WE MANAGE YOUR COOKIES<\/h2>

              You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Blocking cookies may impact your experience.<\/p>

              WHO CAN YOU CONTACT FOR MORE INFORMATION?<\/h2>

              If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or our data handling practices, please reach out to us:<\/p>

              • Phone<\/strong>: (972) 928-0788<\/li>
              • Email<\/strong>: support@pineappleroofingllc.com<\/li>
              • Website<\/strong>: pineappleroofingllc.com<\/li><\/ul>

                Thank you for trusting Pineapple Roofing with your information. OUR SERVICES • COMPLETE ROOFING & EXTERIOR SOLUTIONS

Complete Roofing & Exterior Solutions for Residential and Commercial Properties in Dallas, TX

Pineapple Roofing provides professional roofing, gutter, siding, and storm damage services designed to protect and improve homes and businesses throughout Dallas.

Roof Replacement

Pineapple Roofing provides complete roof replacement services for aging, damaged, and storm-affected properties in Dallas, TX. Every replacement uses durable materials and professional installation focused on long-term protection.

Explore service

Roof Repair

From missing shingles to active leaks, Pineapple Roofing provides responsive roof repair services tailored to your roof's condition. Repairs are completed efficiently to restore integrity and prevent further structural damage.

Explore service

Gutter Installation

Pineapple Roofing installs reliable gutter systems that direct water away from foundations, siding, and landscaping. Properly fitted gutters protect Dallas properties from moisture damage during heavy Texas storms.

Explore service

Siding Installation

Pineapple Roofing offers siding installation services that improve protection, curb appeal, and energy efficiency for Dallas properties. New siding provides long-lasting durability against changing Texas weather conditions.

Explore service

Storm Damage Repair

Pineapple Roofing provides storm damage repair services for wind, hail, and heavy rain impacts across Dallas, TX. We help property owners restore safety and prevent further damage after severe weather.

Explore service Get a Free Quote

Frequently Asked Questions About Roofing Services in Dallas, TX

Find answers to common questions about roofing inspections, replacements, storm damage repairs, and what to expect when you work with Pineapple Roofing.

How do I know if my roof needs replacement or repair?

Signs like recurring leaks, missing shingles, sagging areas, or visible storm damage may indicate the need for professional attention. Pineapple Roofing performs detailed inspections to determine whether targeted repairs or a full roof replacement is the most effective long-term solution.

How long does a roof replacement usually take?

Most residential roof replacements can be completed within a few days depending on the size of the property, material selection, and weather conditions. Pineapple Roofing provides clear scheduling timelines and keeps property owners informed throughout the entire installation process.

Can storm damage cause problems even if leaks are not visible?

Yes. Hail, strong winds, and heavy rain can weaken roofing materials without creating immediate leaks. Pineapple Roofing inspects roofing systems for hidden storm damage that could eventually lead to moisture intrusion, structural issues, or reduced roof lifespan.

Do you work with insurance companies on storm damage claims?

Yes. Pineapple Roofing assists property owners with the documentation and inspection process to help support insurance claims for storm-related roof and exterior damage.

Pineapple Roofing serves Dallas, TX and surrounding communities throughout the North Texas area, providing reliable roofing and exterior services for both residential and commercial properties.

Clarity before commitment.

Our standards

Start with what the roof record can show.

01 / STANDARD

Documentation-First Audit

Drone and ground photography creates a slope-by-slope evidence record before repair recommendations are discussed.

If the answer changes by property, the report should say why.

Roof age, material, slope, ventilation, flashing, previous repairs, storm direction, access, and policy terms can all change the next step. That is why Pineapple starts with documentation.

Polynesian-owned and family-operated, Pineapple Roofing serves North Texas through Tauhi Vā: caring for the relationship, honoring the property, and staying accountable after the build.

Straight answers

Questions before we step on the roof.

What is a CPPA?

A Complimentary Professional Photo Audit is a drone and ground roof inspection that produces a photographic record of visible conditions. You keep the report whether or not you hire Pineapple Roofing.

Can storm damage exist before a leak appears?

Yes. Hail and wind can weaken shingles, flashing, vents, and other roof components before water becomes visible inside. Early documentation helps establish the property’s current condition.

Do you guarantee insurance claim approval?

No. Pineapple Roofing documents visible conditions and can advocate for the documented scope, but the insurance carrier decides coverage under the policy. The homeowner remains responsible for the deductible and policy terms.

What credentials does Pineapple Roofing carry?

Pineapple Roofing is RCAT licensed under #03-0637 and IKO Certified. The company is Polynesian-owned, family-operated, and has served North Texas since 2005.

How do you decide between repair and replacement?

The recommendation considers documented damage, roof age, material condition, repair history, code requirements, and whether a targeted repair can reasonably restore the affected area.

How long does roof work take?

Timing varies by property size, material, weather, permitting, and scope. Pineapple provides a project schedule after the documented scope and material plan are confirmed.

What does a 50-year warranty mean?

Warranty coverage depends on the selected IKO product, registration, installation requirements, and written terms. Review the manufacturer and workmanship documents for exact coverage and exclusions.

Contact Pineapple Roofing

Document the property before the next decision.

Our standards

The field record connects membrane condition, penetrations, drainage, edge metal, traffic areas, and interior reports to a practical scope.

Commercial roofing begins with the operating reality.

01 / STANDARD

Documentation-First Audit

Drone and ground photography creates a slope-by-slope evidence record before repair recommendations are discussed.

02 / STANDARD

Insurance Claim Advocacy

03 / STANDARD

IKO-Certified Installation

Specified materials, disciplined installation, and a final walkthrough protect the workmanship long after the crew leaves.

Roofing and exterior scope

Five coordinated services, one documentation standard.

Service built around the property record.

S-01

Roof Replacement

A documented replacement scope, IKO material options, clean installation, and a final quality record.

S-02

S-03

Storm Damage

S-04

Gutters

Measured drainage systems that move North Texas rain away from fascia, siding, landscaping, and foundations.

Siding

Polynesian-owned and family-operated, Pineapple Roofing serves North Texas through Tauhi Vā: caring for the relationship, honoring the property, and staying accountable after the build.

Straight answers

Questions before we step on the roof.

What is a CPPA?

A Complimentary Professional Photo Audit is a drone and ground roof inspection that produces a photographic record of visible conditions. You keep the report whether or not you hire Pineapple Roofing.

Can storm damage exist before a leak appears?

Yes. Hail and wind can weaken shingles, flashing, vents, and other roof components before water becomes visible inside. Early documentation helps establish the property’s current condition.

Do you guarantee insurance claim approval?

No. Pineapple Roofing documents visible conditions and can advocate for the documented scope, but the insurance carrier decides coverage under the policy. The homeowner remains responsible for the deductible and policy terms.

What credentials does Pineapple Roofing carry?

Pineapple Roofing is RCAT licensed under #03-0637 and IKO Certified. The company is Polynesian-owned, family-operated, and has served North Texas since 2005.

Residential roofing, documented

A roof plan for the whole home.

Pineapple Roofing documents residential roof conditions, explains repair and replacement options, and installs IKO systems for North Texas homes. The CPPA report belongs to the homeowner whether or not work moves forward.

FIELD NOTE / 01

Evidence first. Scope second. Pressure never.

RCAT #03-0637

Our standards

Shingles, flashing, penetrations, ventilation, decking clues, drainage, and related exterior damage are reviewed as one system.

Residential roof scope should be visible before it is priced.

01 / STANDARD

Documentation-First Audit

Drone and ground photography creates a slope-by-slope evidence record before repair recommendations are discussed.

02 / STANDARD

Insurance Claim Advocacy

We organize the documented scope and can meet the adjuster. Coverage decisions remain with the carrier under the homeowner’s policy.

03 / STANDARD

IKO-Certified Installation

Specified materials, disciplined installation, and a final walkthrough protect the workmanship long after the crew leaves.

Roofing and exterior scope

Five coordinated services, one documentation standard.

Service built around the property record.

S-01

Roof Replacement

A documented replacement scope, IKO material options, clean installation, and a final quality record.

S-02

Roof Repair

Targeted repairs based on photographed conditions, not a driveway guess or an automatic replacement pitch.

S-03

Storm Damage

Hail and wind documentation, emergency stabilization, and claim-support evidence without a promise of coverage.

S-04

Gutters

Measured drainage systems that move North Texas rain away from fascia, siding, landscaping, and foundations.

S-05

Siding

Exterior restoration planned alongside the roof when storm damage or age affects the full building envelope.

Verified customer proof

Polynesian-owned and family-operated, Pineapple Roofing serves North Texas through Tauhi Vā: caring for the relationship, honoring the property, and staying accountable after the build.

Straight answers

Questions before we step on the roof.

What is a CPPA?

A Complimentary Professional Photo Audit is a drone and ground roof inspection that produces a photographic record of visible conditions. You keep the report whether or not you hire Pineapple Roofing.

Can storm damage exist before a leak appears?

Yes. Hail and wind can weaken shingles, flashing, vents, and other roof components before water becomes visible inside. Early documentation helps establish the property’s current condition.

Do you guarantee insurance claim approval?

No. Pineapple Roofing documents visible conditions and can advocate for the documented scope, but the insurance carrier decides coverage under the policy. The homeowner remains responsible for the deductible and policy terms.

What credentials does Pineapple Roofing carry?

Pineapple Roofing is RCAT licensed under #03-0637 and IKO Certified. The company is Polynesian-owned, family-operated, and has served North Texas since 2005.

Single-ply commercial roofing

Document the membrane. Protect the operation.

Pineapple Roofing evaluates TPO roof membranes, seams, penetrations, flashing, drainage, attachment, and traffic areas before planning repair or replacement for DFW commercial buildings.

FIELD NOTE / 01

Our standards

A photo record of seams, curbs, drains, edges, punctures, ponding, and prior patches supports a defensible commercial scope.

TPO decisions depend on membrane condition and assembly details.

01 / STANDARD

Documentation-First Audit

Drone and ground photography creates a slope-by-slope evidence record before repair recommendations are discussed.

02 / STANDARD

Insurance Claim Advocacy

We organize the documented scope and can meet the adjuster. Coverage decisions remain with the carrier under the homeowner’s policy.

03 / STANDARD

IKO-Certified Installation

Specified materials, disciplined installation, and a final walkthrough protect the workmanship long after the crew leaves.

Roofing and exterior scope

Five coordinated services, one documentation standard.

Service built around the property record.

S-01

Roof Replacement

A documented replacement scope, IKO material options, clean installation, and a final quality record.

S-02

Roof Repair

Targeted repairs based on photographed conditions, not a driveway guess or an automatic replacement pitch.

S-03

Storm Damage

Hail and wind documentation, emergency stabilization, and claim-support evidence without a promise of coverage.

S-04

Gutters

Measured drainage systems that move North Texas rain away from fascia, siding, landscaping, and foundations.

S-05

Siding

Exterior restoration planned alongside the roof when storm damage or age affects the full building envelope.

Polynesian-owned and family-operated, Pineapple Roofing serves North Texas through Tauhi Vā: caring for the relationship, honoring the property, and staying accountable after the build.

Straight answers

Questions before we step on the roof.

What is a CPPA?

A Complimentary Professional Photo Audit is a drone and ground roof inspection that produces a photographic record of visible conditions. You keep the report whether or not you hire Pineapple Roofing.

Can storm damage exist before a leak appears?

Yes. Hail and wind can weaken shingles, flashing, vents, and other roof components before water becomes visible inside. Early documentation helps establish the property’s current condition.

Do you guarantee insurance claim approval?

No. Pineapple Roofing documents visible conditions and can advocate for the documented scope, but the insurance carrier decides coverage under the policy. The homeowner remains responsible for the deductible and policy terms.

What credentials does Pineapple Roofing carry?

Pineapple Roofing is RCAT licensed under #03-0637 and IKO Certified. The company is Polynesian-owned, family-operated, and has served North Texas since 2005.

Flower Mound, Texas roofing evidence

Flower Mound's Documentation-First Roofing.

Pineapple Roofing serves Flower Mound with a CPPA that documents roof conditions through drone and ground photography. The report supports clear repair, replacement, and storm conversations, and it belongs to the property owner.

FIELD NOTE / 01

Evidence first. Scope second. Pressure never.

Our standards

Flower Mound combines wooded lots, custom homes, steep rooflines, and wind-driven debris. The field record makes those property-specific conditions visible before a scope is selected.

Roofing standards built for Flower Mound properties.

01 / STANDARD

Documentation-First Audit

Drone and ground photography creates a slope-by-slope evidence record before repair recommendations are discussed.

02 / STANDARD

Insurance Claim Advocacy

We organize the documented scope and can meet the adjuster. Coverage decisions remain with the carrier under the homeowner’s policy.

03 / STANDARD

IKO-Certified Installation

Specified materials, disciplined installation, and a final walkthrough protect the workmanship long after the crew leaves.

Roofing and exterior scope

Five coordinated services, one documentation standard.

Service built around the property record.

S-01

Roof Replacement

A documented replacement scope, IKO material options, clean installation, and a final quality record.

S-02

Roof Repair

Targeted repairs based on photographed conditions, not a driveway guess or an automatic replacement pitch.

S-03

Storm Damage

Hail and wind documentation, emergency stabilization, and claim-support evidence without a promise of coverage.

S-04

Gutters

Measured drainage systems that move North Texas rain away from fascia, siding, landscaping, and foundations.

S-05

Siding

Exterior restoration planned alongside the roof when storm damage or age affects the full building envelope.

Verified customer proof

Local roofing knowledge, documented for Flower Mound.

Pineapple’s field process records roof surface, flashing, penetrations, drainage, related exterior conditions, and storm indicators. Recommendations are tied to the property record—not a generic city-page promise.

Polynesian-owned and family-operated, Pineapple Roofing serves North Texas through Tauhi Vā: caring for the relationship, honoring the property, and staying accountable after the build.

Straight answers

Questions before we step on the roof.

What does a CPPA include in Flower Mound?

A Flower Mound CPPA includes drone and ground photography of visible roof and related exterior conditions, an organized findings record, and a follow-up explanation. The property owner keeps the report.

Does Pineapple Roofing serve all of Flower Mound?

Yes. Pineapple Roofing schedules residential and commercial roofing work across Flower Mound and nearby Denton County communities, subject to crew availability, access, safety, and project fit.

Can Pineapple help with a Flower Mound storm claim?

Yes. Pineapple can document visible conditions and discuss the roofing scope with the adjuster. The carrier decides coverage, and the homeowner must pay the deductible and follow the policy.

What roof services are available in Flower Mound?

Pineapple Roofing provides roof replacement, roof repair, storm response, gutters, siding coordination, and residential and commercial roofing options for Flower Mound properties.

How soon should a Flower Mound roof be documented after hail?

Document the roof as soon as it is safe and practical. Conditions can change after later storms, repairs, foot traffic, or weathering, making the original event harder to evaluate.

Contact Pineapple Roofing

Document the property before the next decision.

Little Elm, Texas roofing evidence

Little Elm's Documentation-First Roofing.

Pineapple Roofing serves Little Elm with a CPPA that documents roof conditions through drone and ground photography. The report supports clear repair, replacement, and storm conversations, and it belongs to the property owner.

FIELD NOTE / 01

Evidence first. Scope second. Pressure never.

Our standards

Little Elm combines lake-adjacent winds, newer subdivisions, and rapid development. The field record makes those property-specific conditions visible before a scope is selected.

Roofing standards built for Little Elm properties.

01 / STANDARD

Documentation-First Audit

Drone and ground photography creates a slope-by-slope evidence record before repair recommendations are discussed.

02 / STANDARD

Insurance Claim Advocacy

We organize the documented scope and can meet the adjuster. Coverage decisions remain with the carrier under the homeowner’s policy.

03 / STANDARD

IKO-Certified Installation

Specified materials, disciplined installation, and a final walkthrough protect the workmanship long after the crew leaves.

Roofing and exterior scope

Five coordinated services, one documentation standard.

Service built around the property record.

S-01

Roof Replacement

A documented replacement scope, IKO material options, clean installation, and a final quality record.

S-02

Roof Repair

Targeted repairs based on photographed conditions, not a driveway guess or an automatic replacement pitch.

S-03

Storm Damage

Hail and wind documentation, emergency stabilization, and claim-support evidence without a promise of coverage.

S-04

Gutters

Measured drainage systems that move North Texas rain away from fascia, siding, landscaping, and foundations.

S-05

Siding

Exterior restoration planned alongside the roof when storm damage or age affects the full building envelope.

Verified customer proof

Local roofing knowledge, documented for Little Elm.

Pineapple’s field process records roof surface, flashing, penetrations, drainage, related exterior conditions, and storm indicators. Recommendations are tied to the property record—not a generic city-page promise.

Polynesian-owned and family-operated, Pineapple Roofing serves North Texas through Tauhi Vā: caring for the relationship, honoring the property, and staying accountable after the build.

Straight answers

Questions before we step on the roof.

What does a CPPA include in Little Elm?

A Little Elm CPPA includes drone and ground photography of visible roof and related exterior conditions, an organized findings record, and a follow-up explanation. The property owner keeps the report.

Does Pineapple Roofing serve all of Little Elm?

Yes. Pineapple Roofing schedules residential and commercial roofing work across Little Elm and nearby Denton County communities, subject to crew availability, access, safety, and project fit.

Can Pineapple help with a Little Elm storm claim?

Yes. Pineapple can document visible conditions and discuss the roofing scope with the adjuster. The carrier decides coverage, and the homeowner must pay the deductible and follow the policy.

What roof services are available in Little Elm?

Pineapple Roofing provides roof replacement, roof repair, storm response, gutters, siding coordination, and residential and commercial roofing options for Little Elm properties.

How soon should a Little Elm roof be documented after hail?

Document the roof as soon as it is safe and practical. Conditions can change after later storms, repairs, foot traffic, or weathering, making the original event harder to evaluate.

Contact Pineapple Roofing

Document the property before the next decision.

Plano, Texas roofing evidence

Plano's Documentation-First Roofing.

Our standards

Plano combines mature neighborhoods, complex rooflines, tree cover, and mixed roof ages. The field record makes those property-specific conditions visible before a scope is selected.

Roofing standards built for Plano properties.

01 / STANDARD

Documentation-First Audit

Drone and ground photography creates a slope-by-slope evidence record before repair recommendations are discussed.

02 / STANDARD

Insurance Claim Advocacy

We organize the documented scope and can meet the adjuster. Coverage decisions remain with the carrier under the homeowner’s policy.

03 / STANDARD

IKO-Certified Installation

Specified materials, disciplined installation, and a final walkthrough protect the workmanship long after the crew leaves.

Roofing and exterior scope

Five coordinated services, one documentation standard.

Service built around the property record.

S-01

Roof Replacement

A documented replacement scope, IKO material options, clean installation, and a final quality record.

S-02

Roof Repair

Targeted repairs based on photographed conditions, not a driveway guess or an automatic replacement pitch.

S-03

Storm Damage

Hail and wind documentation, emergency stabilization, and claim-support evidence without a promise of coverage.

S-04

Gutters

Measured drainage systems that move North Texas rain away from fascia, siding, landscaping, and foundations.

S-05

Siding

Exterior restoration planned alongside the roof when storm damage or age affects the full building envelope.

Verified customer proof

Local roofing knowledge, documented for Plano.

Pineapple’s field process records roof surface, flashing, penetrations, drainage, related exterior conditions, and storm indicators. Recommendations are tied to the property record—not a generic city-page promise.

Polynesian-owned and family-operated, Pineapple Roofing serves North Texas through Tauhi Vā: caring for the relationship, honoring the property, and staying accountable after the build.

Straight answers

Questions before we step on the roof.

What does a CPPA include in Plano?

A Plano CPPA includes drone and ground photography of visible roof and related exterior conditions, an organized findings record, and a follow-up explanation. The property owner keeps the report.

Does Pineapple Roofing serve all of Plano?

Yes. Pineapple Roofing schedules residential and commercial roofing work across Plano and nearby Collin County communities, subject to crew availability, access, safety, and project fit.

Can Pineapple help with a Plano storm claim?

Yes. Pineapple can document visible conditions and discuss the roofing scope with the adjuster. The carrier decides coverage, and the homeowner must pay the deductible and follow the policy.

What roof services are available in Plano?

Pineapple Roofing provides roof replacement, roof repair, storm response, gutters, siding coordination, and residential and commercial roofing options for Plano properties.

How soon should a Plano roof be documented after hail?

Document the roof as soon as it is safe and practical. Conditions can change after later storms, repairs, foot traffic, or weathering, making the original event harder to evaluate.

Contact Pineapple Roofing

Document the property before the next decision.

RCAT #03-0637 / IKO Certified
(972) 928-0788Reserve Your Complimentary Professional Photo Audit.

The Colony, Texas roofing evidence

The Colony's Documentation-First Roofing.

Pineapple Roofing serves The Colony with a CPPA that documents roof conditions through drone and ground photography. The report supports clear repair, replacement, and storm conversations, and it belongs to the property owner.

FIELD NOTE / 01

Evidence first. Scope second. Pressure never.

RCAT #03-0637
IKO Certified / The Colony

Reserve your roof audit.

Send the property details. A Pineapple team member will call to confirm the CPPA appointment.

Your information is used only to coordinate the requested roof audit.RCAT #03-0637 / IKO Certified

5.0★ / 200+ reviewsLicense #03-0637IKO Certified50-year warrantySince 2005

As certified & recognized

NMSDC / Minority-OwnedIKO CertifiedBBB ProfileNorth Texas Since 2005

Our standards

The Colony combines Lewisville Lake exposure, fast-moving storms, and expanding neighborhoods. The field record makes those property-specific conditions visible before a scope is selected.

Roofing standards built for The Colony properties.

01 / STANDARD

Documentation-First Audit

Drone and ground photography creates a slope-by-slope evidence record before repair recommendations are discussed.

02 / STANDARD

Insurance Claim Advocacy

We organize the documented scope and can meet the adjuster. Coverage decisions remain with the carrier under the homeowner’s policy.

03 / STANDARD

IKO-Certified Installation

Specified materials, disciplined installation, and a final walkthrough protect the workmanship long after the crew leaves.

Roofing and exterior scope

Five coordinated services, one documentation standard.

Service built around the property record.

S-01

Roof Replacement

A documented replacement scope, IKO material options, clean installation, and a final quality record.

S-02

Roof Repair

Targeted repairs based on photographed conditions, not a driveway guess or an automatic replacement pitch.

S-03

Storm Damage

Hail and wind documentation, emergency stabilization, and claim-support evidence without a promise of coverage.

S-04

Gutters

Measured drainage systems that move North Texas rain away from fascia, siding, landscaping, and foundations.

S-05

Siding

Exterior restoration planned alongside the roof when storm damage or age affects the full building envelope.

Verified customer proof

Local roofing knowledge, documented for The Colony.

Pineapple’s field process records roof surface, flashing, penetrations, drainage, related exterior conditions, and storm indicators. Recommendations are tied to the property record—not a generic city-page promise.

Polynesian-owned and family-operated, Pineapple Roofing serves North Texas through Tauhi Vā: caring for the relationship, honoring the property, and staying accountable after the build.

Straight answers

Questions before we step on the roof.

What does a CPPA include in The Colony?

A The Colony CPPA includes drone and ground photography of visible roof and related exterior conditions, an organized findings record, and a follow-up explanation. The property owner keeps the report.

Does Pineapple Roofing serve all of The Colony?

Yes. Pineapple Roofing schedules residential and commercial roofing work across The Colony and nearby Denton County communities, subject to crew availability, access, safety, and project fit.

Can Pineapple help with a The Colony storm claim?

Yes. Pineapple can document visible conditions and discuss the roofing scope with the adjuster. The carrier decides coverage, and the homeowner must pay the deductible and follow the policy.

What roof services are available in The Colony?

Pineapple Roofing provides roof replacement, roof repair, storm response, gutters, siding coordination, and residential and commercial roofing options for The Colony properties.

How soon should a The Colony roof be documented after hail?

Document the roof as soon as it is safe and practical. Conditions can change after later storms, repairs, foot traffic, or weathering, making the original event harder to evaluate.

Document the property before the next decision.

title.raw: Metal vs. Shingle Roofing in Texas: Which Is Right for Your Home?
title.rendered: Metal vs. Shingle Roofing in Texas: Which Is Right for Your Home?

content.raw:
It's one of the most common questions North Texas homeowners ask us: should I go with shingles or metal? Both are excellent choices — the right one depends on your budget, how long you plan to stay, and the look you want. Here's an honest breakdown.

Cost **Shingles** are the more budget-friendly option up front and fit the majority of DFW homes. **Metal** costs more to install, but spreads that cost over a much longer lifespan. If you're staying in the home long-term, the math often favors metal.

Lifespan - **Architectural shingles:** roughly 15–25 years in the North Texas climate. - **Standing-seam metal:** roughly 40–70 years.

A quality metal roof can genuinely be the last roof you ever buy.

Hail and wind performance This matters a lot here. Both can be rated for impact — **Class 4 impact-rated shingles** perform very well and can even lower your insurance premium. **Metal** also handles hail and high winds excellently, though large hail can dent some panels cosmetically. For most homeowners, either option stands up to North Texas storms when installed correctly.

Energy efficiency **Metal** reflects heat and can reduce summer cooling costs — a real advantage through a Texas July. **Shingles** have improved with reflective and "cool roof" options, but metal still leads on energy performance.

Curb appeal **Shingles** offer a classic look with a huge range of colors and profiles, including designer options. **Metal** gives a modern, distinctive look and is increasingly popular for accents and full roofs on higher-end homes.

So which should you choose? | | Shingles | Metal | |---|---|---| | Up-front cost | Lower | Higher | | Lifespan | 15–25 yrs | 40–70 yrs | | Energy savings | Good | Best | | Best for | Most homes, tighter budgets | Long-term owners, modern look |

There's no wrong answer — only the right fit for *your* home, roof slope and budget.

Let's figure it out together — at no cost As an IKO Certified contractor trained across the full shingle line and experienced with standing-seam metal, we help you choose based on your actual roof, not a sales quota. It starts with a **Complimentary Professional Photo Audit (CPPA)** — a documented look at your roof and an honest recommendation.

We've served North Texas since 2005, we're RCAT licensed (#03-0637), and 5-star rated by 400+ homeowners. That's The Pineapple Standard.

title.raw: 7 Signs You Need a Roof Replacement in Dallas-Fort Worth
title.rendered: 7 Signs You Need a Roof Replacement in Dallas-Fort Worth

content.raw:
North Texas is hard on roofs. Between hail, high winds and triple-digit summers, even a well-built roof ages faster here than almost anywhere in the country. The question most homeowners face isn't *if* they'll need work — it's whether a repair will do, or whether it's time for a full replacement.

Here are seven signs it's leaning toward replacement.

1. Your roof is 15–20+ years old Most asphalt shingle roofs in DFW last 15–25 years depending on the product and the weather they've survived. If yours is in that range and has taken a few hail seasons, it's worth a professional look.

2. Widespread hail bruising A few damaged shingles can be repaired. But when hail has bruised shingles across the whole roof — knocking off granules and exposing the mat — spot repairs won't keep up. Widespread bruising usually points to replacement, and it's often an insurance claim.

3. Granules filling your gutters Those sandy granules protect your shingles from UV. When you're finding piles of them in the gutters, the surface is wearing out — and bare spots follow fast.

4. Curling, cracking or missing shingles Shingles that are curling at the edges, cracking, or blowing off in wind are past their prime. A patch here and there is fine; a roof full of them is a system at end of life.

5. Leaks in more than one spot A single leak from a flashing failure can be repaired. Multiple leaks, or stains showing up in different rooms, usually mean the underlayment and decking are compromised in several places.

6. Sagging or soft spots A sagging roofline or soft, spongy areas underfoot signal moisture in the decking or structure. That's not a cosmetic issue — it's a replacement (and sometimes structural) conversation.

7. Daylight or moisture in the attic If you can see daylight through the roof boards, or the attic feels damp and smells musty, water is getting in. Catch it early and you protect the structure; wait, and the repair bill climbs.

Repair or replace? Get a documented answer first You don't have to guess. Every Pineapple Contractors project starts with a **Complimentary Professional Photo Audit (CPPA)** — our IKO Certified team documents the roof, attic and exterior with photos and gives you an honest, written read: repair, replace, and whether it's an insurance claim. No cost, no pressure.

We've protected North Texas homes since 2005, we're RCAT licensed (#03-0637), IKO Certified, and 5-star rated by 400+ homeowners. That's The Pineapple Standard.

Seeing one or more of these signs? Book your CPPA today. 📞 Call (972) 928-0788 or request an inspection online.

title.rendered: Storm Damage Roof Inspection in Frisco, TX: What to Do First

content.raw:
North Texas storms don't ask permission. One hail event or high-wind night can leave your Frisco roof with damage you can't see from the ground — and by the time a leak shows up inside, the problem is usually bigger (and costlier) than it had to be.

Here's exactly what to do after a storm, how a professional roof inspection works, and how to keep your options open with insurance.

First, stay off the roof It's tempting to grab a ladder and look for yourself. Don't. Wet or hail-battered roofing is slick and unstable, and untrained eyes miss the damage that matters most — bruised shingles, lifted flashing, and compromised seals. A ground-level look plus a few photos of any obvious debris is all you need before calling a professional.

What storm damage actually looks like After a North Texas storm, a trained inspector checks for:

- Hail bruising — soft, dark spots where the granules are knocked off, exposing the mat underneath. Often invisible from the ground. - Wind-lifted or missing shingles — especially along ridges and edges. - Damaged flashing — around chimneys, vents and valleys, where leaks usually start. - Granules in the gutters — a sign the shingle surface is wearing prematurely. - Interior clues — ceiling stains, attic moisture, or daylight through the decking.

Any one of these can turn into an interior leak if it's left alone through the next storm.

How a professional inspection works At Pineapple Contractors, every storm inspection starts with a **Complimentary Professional Photo Audit (CPPA)**. Our IKO Certified team documents the roof, attic and exterior with photos — no cost, no pressure — and gives you a clear, written read on what we see: what's urgent, what can wait, and whether you're looking at a repair or a replacement.

That documentation matters for two reasons: it tells you the true condition of your roof, and it becomes the evidence you need if you decide to file an insurance claim.

The insurance side (and why documentation wins) Most storm-damage roof work in Texas is handled through a homeowner's insurance claim. The key is documentation done right, early. When you work with us:

1. We photograph and document the damage with a written scope. 2. We meet your adjuster on site so nothing gets missed or downplayed. 3. We walk the claim alongside you — you're never negotiating with the insurance company alone.

You always decide whether to file. Our job is to make sure that if you do, the damage is documented thoroughly and fairly.

Why Frisco homeowners choose Pineapple - **Local since 2005** — we're based in North Texas, not a storm-chasing crew that disappears after the next hail event. - **IKO Certified** — certified installs backed by 50-year product warranties. - **RCAT License #03-0637** — a licensed, accountable Texas contractor. - **5-star rated** by 400+ North Texas homeowners.

That's The Pineapple Standard: careful work, clear communication, and a family-run team that treats your home like our own.

Don't wait for the leak The most expensive roof problems are the ones that sit through one more storm. If a recent storm rolled through Frisco or the surrounding DFW area, the smartest first step costs you nothing: **book your Complimentary Professional Photo Audit.**

📞 Call (972) 928-0788 or request an inspection online — and get a documented answer before the next storm makes the decision for you.

---

*Pineapple Contractors · IKO Certified · RCAT License #03-0637 · 5-Star Rated · Serving Frisco, Plano, McKinney & all of Dallas–Fort Worth since 2005.*
